hero.name: Md. Ayubur Rahaman
hero.statement: I build high-performance web, mobile, and AI-powered applications focused on scalability, seamless user experiences, and intelligent automation.

about.label: // about
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Software Engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, currently working as a Software Engineer II at ShellBeeHaken Ltd. I specialize in building scalable web and mobile applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, React Native, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

Beyond traditional full-stack development, I'm passionate about AI engineering and Agentic AI systems. I enjoy designing intelligent applications powered by LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and real-time communication technologies, combining modern software engineering with practical AI solutions.

I focus on building maintainable, scalable, and high-performance systems with clean architecture and thoughtful developer experience. Whether I'm designing APIs, optimizing databases, implementing event-driven services, or developing AI-powered workflows, I aim to create software that's reliable, efficient, and easy to evolve.

items.name: FAM Sports Nutrition Learning Platform
items.description: An interactive learning platform training professional sports nutrition advisors through structured courses and one-on-one consultations, across web and mobile.
outcomes: Developed and maintained both the admin and customer-facing web apps, plus built a cross-platform mobile app for iOS and Android.
Shipped an AI-powered chat feature to assist users with guidance and interactive learning.
Built consultation modules to facilitate communication between users and advisors.
Implemented multiple payment and subscription flows, enabling flexible access to platform content.

items.name: KriyaKarak
items.description: A secure platform unifying service providers from across Bangladesh onto a single digital marketplace.
outcomes: Owned the Expert Portfolio Module end-to-end — frontend architecture, UI, and feature integration.
Improved service scheduling and booking workflows in the Booking Module.

items.name: Mapage
items.description: A branding platform for freelance beauticians in Japan, enabling them to build a personal brand and offer beauty services to customers
outcomes: Developed and maintained customer-facing web app, plus built a cross-platform mobile app for iOS and Android.
Implemented the stylist portfolio management module, allowing beauticians to showcase their work and personal brand effectively.

items.name: Gorillamove: Grocery delivery
items.description: An instant grocery delivery service in Bangladesh, commited to effectively serving customers and the planet a little better every day.
outcomes: Owned total mobile frontend architecture to design, develop, and integrate core features and functionalities
Implemented payment gateway systems on the frontend.

impact: Built scalable full-stack applications with Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, including complex aggregation pipelines and query optimization.
Designed event-driven workflows using AWS Lambda, WebSockets, and Redis for real-time features and background processing.
Designed and developed Agentic AI solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, LangChain,LangGraph, MCP, and intelligent automation to solve complex business problems.
Developed cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and containerized services with Docker for consistent deployments.
Designed and built the UI for the organization's ERP system in Angular, and its e-commerce platform in React.js and Next.js.
Built a cross-platform mobile application with React Native.
Developed backend services in PHP with optimized PostgreSQL databases and queries.
